user_username_canonical_check.name: user_username_canonical_check
user_username_canonical_check.value: length("user"."username") BETWEEN 3 AND 30 AND "user"."username" GLOB '[a-z]*' AND "user"."username" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*'

ledger_balance_correction_amount_check.name: ledger_balance_correction_amount_check
ledger_balance_correction_amount_check.value: "ledger_balance_correction"."amount_minor" <> '0' AND (("ledger_balance_correction"."amount_minor" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr("ledger_balance_correction"."amount_minor", 1, 1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9') OR (substr("ledger_balance_correction"."amount_minor", 1, 1) = '-' AND substr("ledger_balance_correction"."amount_minor", 2) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr("ledger_balance_correction"."amount_minor", 2, 1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9'))

ledger_transaction_transfer_check.name: ledger_transaction_transfer_check
ledger_transaction_transfer_check.value: ("ledger_transaction"."source" = 'manual' AND "ledger_transaction"."transfer_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_transaction"."transfer_side" IS NULL) OR ("ledger_transaction"."source" = 'transfer' AND "ledger_transaction"."transfer_id" IS NOT NULL AND (("ledger_transaction"."transfer_side" = 'from' AND "ledger_transaction"."kind" = 'expense') OR ("ledger_transaction"."transfer_side" = 'to' AND "ledger_transaction"."kind" = 'income')))

planned_exception_change_check.name: planned_exception_change_check
planned_exception_change_check.value: ("planned_occurrence_exception"."action"='skip' AND "planned_occurrence_exception"."changed_date" IS NULL AND "planned_occurrence_exception"."changed_amount_minor" IS NULL AND "planned_occurrence_exception"."changed_status" IS NULL) OR ("planned_occurrence_exception"."action"='change' AND ("planned_occurrence_exception"."changed_date" IS NOT NULL OR "planned_occurrence_exception"."changed_amount_minor" IS NOT NULL OR "planned_occurrence_exception"."changed_status" IS NOT NULL))

planned_series_date_check.name: planned_series_date_check
planned_series_date_check.value: "planned_series"."date" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND "planned_series"."effective_from" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND ("planned_series"."cutoff_date" IS NULL OR "planned_series"."cutoff_date" >= "planned_series"."effective_from")

planned_series_recurrence_check.name: planned_series_recurrence_check
planned_series_recurrence_check.value: ("planned_series"."recurrence_frequency" IS NULL AND "planned_series"."recurrence_interval" IS NULL AND "planned_series"."recurrence_end_date" IS NULL) OR ("planned_series"."recurrence_frequency" IN ('weekly','monthly','yearly') AND "planned_series"."recurrence_interval" > 0 AND ("planned_series"."recurrence_end_date" IS NULL OR "planned_series"."recurrence_end_date" >= "planned_series"."date"))

workspace_personal_owner_check.name: workspace_personal_owner_check
workspace_personal_owner_check.value: ("workspace"."type" = 'personal' AND "workspace"."personal_owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("workspace"."type" = 'household' AND "workspace"."personal_owner_user_id" IS NULL)
